question:
A triangular park has vertices $P(-2,4)$, $Q(3,-1)$, and $R(5,5)$.

(a) Calculate its area using a determinant.

(b) A point $S(t,2)$ is chosen so that the area of $\triangle PQS$ is half the area of $\triangle PQR$. Determine all possible values of $t$.

(c) Verify the area of $\triangle PQS$ for each value of $t$.

options.A:
(a) Area of $\triangle PQR=20$ square units
(b) $t=4$ only
(c) Area of $\triangle PQS=10$ square units
options.B:
(a) Area of $\triangle PQR=20$ square units
(b) $t=4$ or $t=-4$
(c) For both values, area of $\triangle PQS=10$ square units
options.C:
(a) Area of $\triangle PQR=40$ square units
(b) $t=4$ or $t=-4$
(c) For both values, area of $\triangle PQS=20$ square units
options.D:
(a) Area of $\triangle PQR=20$ square units
(b) $t=2$ or $t=-2$
(c) For both values, area of $\triangle PQS=5$ square units
